targetInputs.label: Jalak death time
targetInputs.tooltip: Simulation time (in seconds) at which to disable War-God Jalak and trigger the Rampage buff on Horridon. If set longer than the simulated fight length, then Jalak will be tanked the entire time and Rampage will never be triggered.

targetInputs.label: Taunt swap for Triple Puncture
targetInputs.tooltip: If checked, taunt swap upon Jalak's death and on every other Triple Puncture application afterwards in order to limit stack accumulation on a single tank.
